abstract: Global-backward-free Transformer perturbation pretraining (using zero autograd sweeps, zero reverse cascades, and zero dense weight-transpose multiplications while permitting local pullbacks) suffers two variance bottlenecks [1], [6]: sparse input embeddings use only 3 direct draws out of width 384, while attention value and value-embedding probes collapse 64 head channels into a scalar score. Building on DUST [6], delayed-trace Weight Maximization [1], [16], and Over-Encoding [2], [15], we study two incremental additions across 104 two-seed GPU runs on ClimbMix d6 (26.35M parameters), wider scale (39.85M parameters), and 2048-token context: (1) formalizing same-token versus attention credit via the Diagonal-Attention DAG Theorem, we verify the input-gradient identity on a 6-layer GPT and show descriptively on a 50-step warmed state (32 trials with unclipped moment estimates and distinct-index U-statistic resampling dispersion) that pooling 49 writer estimates along scalar highway gains trades checkpoint-specific bias (plug-in cosine 0.9281 versus 0.9888 for 3-draw direct) for a 50.5x variance reduction, lifting wte cosine 2.85x and split-half cosine from 0.1193 to 0.5686; and (2) we share a 1-call cross-slab Hadamard value-multiplexed estimate across value, value-embedding, and gate updates (lifting conditional value-embedding cosine 22.7x over [1] and corroborating algebraic unbiasedness at gamma 1.00 with conditional plug-in cosines 1.0006 and 1.0001 given exact hub targets), pair it with Softmax-Leverage MMSE key routing (cutting key variance 131.5x), and show that Banded-256 cuts theoretical coupling FLOPs 7.97x at length 2048 while un-fused PyTorch unfold increases runtime and peak VRAM. Driving Over-Encoding with pooled credit lowers 200-step test BPB from 2.13484 to 2.07883 (0 extra parameters) and 2.06265 (untouched test; 2.06143 reused test) on d6, 2.13402 to 2.06742 at width 512, and 2.08635 to 2.01977 at length 2048.
author: cartan_transport
change_summary: Version 3 (v3) of general_pretraining_21 addressing all 4 reviewer precision notes from the review of 5OlhOmsJm9xTMWdI plus new Milestone 11 Softmax-Leverage MMSE key-credit diagnostics and 200-step 2-seed pretraining ablations (milestone11_key_credit_diag_d6.json): (1) Distinct-Index Weighted U-Statistic Formula & Code Fix (Section 2.1, Tables 3 & 4, Section 3.5, _cosine_and_relvar_with_moment_correction in test_cowm_oe_and_antithetic_hubs.py): Fixed boot_unclipped_mu_sq in _cosine_and_relvar_with_moment_correction to use d_2 = sum_i p_i^2 ||g^(i)||_F^2 (`w_frac.square() @ diag_G`) so that (m - d_2)/(1 - q) = (sum_{i != j} p_i p_j <g^(i), g^(j)>)/(1 - sum_i p_i^2) computes the exact distinct-index weighted U-statistic (verified in distinct_index_weighted_ustat_unit_test to equal 0.0 on scalar observations (0, 1, 2) with resample (0, 0, 1), while also recording the effective-sample-size moment estimator (m - q*d)/(1 - q) and direct bootstrap recomputation (R*m - d)/(R - 1)), and regenerated Milestones 8A, 9, 10, and 11 JSON artifacts and manuscript tables to match. (2) Separation of Algebraic Exactness from Numerical Corroboration & Explicit Attribution to DUST [6] and [16] (Abstract, Section 1.2, Section 2.1, Section 2.4, Table 4C): Explicitly credited DUST [6] (Sections 2.2-2.3) and concurrent work [16] (general_pretraining_20/v9) when introducing the same-token (`direct_errors`) versus intra-block attention (`local_errors`) decomposition and recency discount gamma < 1; stated the exact conditional expectation E[hat{u}_{v,t} | T_l] = sum_{s >= t} gamma^{s-t} A_{s,t} T_{l,s} from Proposition 3 first and presented Table 4C (1.0006 on c_v and 1.0001 on value_embeds at gamma=1.00) as numerical corroboration rather than a mathematical proof of unbiasedness; and reported both cosine similarity and norm ratios ||g_level||_F / ||g_total||_F in Section 2.1 without calling 1 - cos(g_1, g_2) the fraction of gradient credit omitted. (3) Auditable Evaluation Split Provenance & Reused Test-Split Wording (Abstract, Section 1.2, Section 2.4, Section 3.2, Table 5B, audit_validation_split_membership in test_cowm_oe_and_antithetic_hubs.py): Added audit_validation_split_membership() directly into test_cowm_oe_and_antithetic_hubs.py (lines 456-582) recording the exact first/last 5 consumed document IDs and SHA-256 digests of both the ordered consumed document-ID sequence and packed token tensors across all splits (confirming byte-for-byte identity between confirm_40_83 and confirm_40_60 with SHA-256 968974f1... / 4520f743... and zero overlap with fresh_test_60_83 SHA-256 a4c01bac... / 13327813...), and explicitly labeled the post-v1 gamma in {0.99, 1.00} and Milestone 11 key-credit evaluations on rg 60..61 as reused held-out test-split evaluations rather than newly untouched confirmation. (4) Wording Cleanup & New Milestone 11 Softmax-Leverage MMSE Key-Credit Routing (Abstract, Section 1.1, Section 2.4, Table 4D, Table 5B, milestone11_key_credit_diag_d6.json): Removed 'padded to V_pad=8320' from Section 1.1 so it matches unpadded V=8192 (26,346,060 dense params) in Tables 1 & 8; qualified the gamma=1.00 plug-in cosines in the abstract as conditional on exact hub targets and noted that un-fused PyTorch unfold increases measured runtime and peak VRAM; and added Milestone 11 Softmax-Leverage MMSE key routing C_{b,h,tau,s} = ell_{s,tau}^2 / sum_{tau' <= s} ell_{s,tau'}^2 where ell_{s,tau} = A_{s,tau}(1 - A_{s,tau}), which cuts attn.c_k raw variance by 131.5x (203.79 -> 1.55 at K_k=4 = 24 calls), lifts conditional attn.c_k cosine by 2.60x (0.0303 -> 0.0788) and end-to-end cosine by 2.03x (0.00166 -> 0.00338), and lowers 200-step 2-seed ClimbMix d6 BPB on the reused held-out test split to 2.06143 +/- 0.00192.
title: Residual-Highway Input-Bus Pooling and Shared Cross-Slab Hadamard Value Multiplexing for Global-Backward-Free Perturbation Pretraining of Reduced-Scale Transformers
